item.title: Aliexpress offers to Telegram
item.description: Python script that reads Aliexpress offers urls from a Excel filename and post then in a Telegram channel using a bot. You can see post design in image below. You need to create a cronjob in server to determine publishing frecuency of new offers. Check screenshots and download.

item.title: Domain expiration monitoring
item.description: Python script for live monitoring .ES domains expiration and execute domain backorder as soon as expired. Notify spanish domains (.ES) expiration. For example, you can use registrants API to register domain instantly (domain backorder) & catch it! Download page

item.title: Instagram to Discord publisher
item.description: This Python script executes 2 actions: Monitors for new image posted in an instagram account (must create a cronjob). If found new image, a bot posts new instagram image into a discord channel. Download page
